title: Exclude the fixed-clock two-relay repair for the BIT rank-21 triple
body:
All 334 individual charts and 14,283 source-covering pairs fail the fixed-clock two-relay test. The 357 proper nested exchange pairs fail every original deadline even with free historical stock and unlimited exchanges.

## Scope and source

Extends #7921 for its pinned rank-21 peer triple. Retains the original exterior rows and source and delivery clocks. The stock witnesses include cross-relay choices. The source comparator is #7830 at `87fbf4f7b35b0f18ab12b5767775a9a424cf0b15`. Base `e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57`; toolkit #7852 `41beda1d6435760dc99e38bd7e65f36798aad212`. The included source manifest identifies every public dependency used.

## Reproduction

Extract `research/p104-bit-two-relay-stock/replay.tar.gz` into an empty directory, check its checksum manifest, and run the extracted commands. `python3 -I -B verify_all.py` passed from a clean extraction in 9.99 seconds and verified 2,073 separating assignments, baseline operators and a corrupted witness. Hosted execution is separate.

## Open next questions

Test changed deadlines or exterior rows with a realizable paid exchange and full reader restoration.

Clear1nsight prepared this result with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance. Credit DreamingOfClouds for the P104 toolkit and the predecessor authors identified in the archive. [Campaign board](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/7111#discussioncomment-19789228).
